design: answer-design.json pins matrix, selected split/cases, canonical tree, runtime, repetitions, variants and deterministic grader criteria
commit: artifact-commit.json is written last and binds the exact complete file inventory
comparison: same design, case, repetition; exactly with_skill and without_skill; all design cells required
grades: text-predicate-v1 reruns deterministic criteria against committed output; judges cannot override deterministic failure
leakage_boundary: design/labels/graders stay evaluator-private, never placed in runner workspace
ablation: materialized file-removal ablation plus canonical-parent/tree hashes; no prompt-simulated ablation
capture: process/provider/trace channels must be complete; fixture is never live evidence
remote_submission: not implemented; no automatic retries or uncertain resubmission
